program_dir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0 and r > 0 and rows - r - 1 == r:
            first, second = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(x, y)] for x, y in zip(first, second)]
    for c in range(cols):
        value = grid[0][c]
        if value != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == value for r in range(rows)) and c > 0 and cols - c - 1 == c:
            return [[2 if grid[r][j] != 0 and grid[r][c + 1 + j] != 0 else 0 for j in range(c)] for r in range(rows)]
    raise ValueError("No centered uniform divider with equal-sized panels")
'''
program_path=program_dir/'task-3cb2206b.py'
program_path.write_text(source)
print(program_path, source)
